field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Row-derived aggregates catch summaries that disagree with terminal evidence.
field_principles.artifact_hash_manifest: Hashes bind each terminal determination to the exact evidence bytes.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time detects a bootstrap-only artifact.
field_principles.exact_energy_evidence_boundary: The boundary preserves Exp6478 as a finite no-LLM result and prevents a false local-SOTA claim.

field_principles.field_provenance: Exact source paths and hashes make each value traceable.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Any blocked verdict names the failed check, expected value, observed value, and evidence path.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict states completion and each branch boundary without promoting a science claim.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declaring aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts prevents a no-model audit from being read as live inference.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Task rows make every aggregate and branch boundary independently checkable.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Precondition receipts prove the expected artifacts and repository state existed before aggregation.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: The task must not alter the active roadmap, conductor, registry, or public results.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed makes attack ordering reproducible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A stable checksum detects later drift in inputs or the terminal artifact.
field_principles.retirement_boundary_rows: Explicit rows keep the invalid Exp6463 lineage from returning under a new name.
field_principles.roadmap_activation_performed: A false value keeps evidence aggregation separate from conductor state changes.
field_principles.staged_queue_validation_performed: A false value proves this task did not repeat the retired queue-transition scope.
field_principles.status: A terminal status distinguishes a completed evidence freeze from an interrupted handoff.
field_principles.tests_run: Recorded commands distinguish executed checks from intended checks.
field_principles.unrelated_branch_gate_count: Zero unrelated gates prevents an infrastructure result from suppressing independent science.
field_principles.v557_arc_shield_ready_score: A narrow score confirms the generic no-solve shield without claiming policy improvement.
field_principles.v557_factor_cache_ready_score: A narrow score gives later CSL work a same-roadmap gate without granting benefit or release authority.
field_principles.v557_terminal_rows: One row per active V557 task prevents missing or blocked evidence from disappearing in a summary.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Only deterministic hashes and row arithmetic are authoritative in this task.
